Premise: code read on origin/main 7752cac7 (live repro owed before code). The repro path (商机 → 相关 → 商机产品明细 → delete a row) is the related list: `RelatedList.tsx` ~:3181 renders `detail.deleteRowConfirmation` with `getRecordDisplayName(objectSchema, deleteTarget)`, and that resolver (`ui/packages/core/src/utils/record-title.ts:558`) reads `objectDef.nameField` first and falls to `Record #<id>` (:638) only when the row has no name value. Candidate cause, NOT yet measured: the list's `$select` projection (~:1225-1275) asks for the authored columns, `id`, `$expand` roots, predicate operands and the gallery cover, but not the object's `nameField`, so a row whose name column is not shown reaches the dialog without `product_title`. Other candidates: `objectSchema` not settled at delete time; a different confirm path. If the cause is elsewhere or wider (e.g. every list surface that names a row from a projected row), the dev stops and reports.
